statements.attributed: Identified two mechanisms of nanoparticle generation: ultrasmall NPs from nucleation and condensation in a low-density mixing region in a supercritical state, and larger NPs from a highly dynamic molten layer due to Rayleigh–Taylor instability

statements.quote: The presence of different size fractions in the colloids that were produced can be assigned to distinct particle formation mechanisms in the picosecond-pulsed laser synthesis of colloids. Whereas ultrasmall NPs originate from nucleation and condensation in a low-density mixing region of the ablated metal species and the liquid environment in a supercritical state, larger NPs emerge from a highly dynamic molten layer on the surface of the ablation target due to Rayleigh–Taylor instability.
